dogecoin.text:
@dogecoin_empire If I ever have an emergency that forces me to run out of my house, the last thing I'm going to worry about is whether I'm naked. 

To be honest, in an emergency I'd be more likely to grab my weapons than my clothes.

@dogecoin_empire Most women should not try buying him tools, because most women don't have the judgment required to pick the stuff that's both good and appropriate, and you leave him in the awkward position of having to praise a gift that was well intentioned but not quite right.
@dogecoin_empire "Honey, I bought you some ammunition. Let's go to the range."
